name: Reflex Arc Neural Pathway
semanticDescription: Complete 3D neural pathway model of a somatic reflex arc illustrating skin heat/pain receptor, afferent sensory neuron, spinal cord butterfly cross-section with interneuron, efferent motor neuron, and effector muscle (CBSE Class 10 Biology Ch 6 Figure 6.2).
simplifications: Nerve pathways shown as continuous color-coded axon fiber bundles.
Spinal cord segment displayed in anatomical transverse cross-section.

materials.look: Human finger skin dermal receptor pad (natural flesh tone)
Afferent sensory nerve fiber (luminescent cobalt blue)
Butterfly-shaped central spinal gray matter (soft warm gray/taupe)
Efferent motor nerve fiber (vibrant crimson red)
Striated arm flexor muscle block (deep muscular crimson)
